_readme: MCP servers registered in BOTH agents by `aos sync` (Claude: user scope; Codex: ~/.codex/config.toml).
Keep this list short: every server's tool schemas are loaded into every request.
Rule of thumb: add a server only when a CLI can't do the job and the need has already repeated.
GitHub goes through `gh`, browsers through the agents' built-in browser tools - no servers needed.

context7.why: Current, version-specific library docs for both agents. Free tier works without a key.

nar.why: Local, calibrated single-pass (non-autoregressive) scoring of options; agents call it only when a choice among known alternatives benefits from it.
